learning_outcomes.text: Design a conversational analytics architecture over BigQuery
Model data and a semantic layer for trustworthy answers
Translate natural-language questions to validated SQL
Ground model output in query results and schema
Present results through Looker and controlled dashboards
Govern access, cost and accuracy of the system

integrative_case: A business team wants to ask questions of warehouse data in plain language: model the BigQuery schema and a semantic layer, translate questions into validated SQL grounded in the schema, verify results, surface them through Looker, and enforce access, cost controls and accuracy checks before launch.
